__package__.yml.rawContents:
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    UpdateDomain:
      path: /domain
      method: PATCH
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request: UpdateDomainRequest
      examples:
        - request:
            autorenewEnabled: true
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
types:
  UpdateDomainRequestAutorenewEnabled:
    properties:
      autorenewEnabled: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  UpdateDomainRequestPrivacyEnabled:
    properties:
      privacyEnabled: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  UpdateDomainRequestLocked:
    properties:
      locked: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  UpdateDomainRequest:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      autorenewEnabled: optional<boolean>
      privacyEnabled: optional<boolean>
      locked: optional<boolean>
    union:
      - UpdateDomainRequestAutorenewEnabled
      - UpdateDomainRequestPrivacyEnabled
      - UpdateDomainRequestLocked
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml

contents.display-name: Test spec for the preserve-any-of-as-union setting.
